notes.title: Version 0.1.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
What's in this build?
This release contains the first two chapters of the game, available for free. It also includes some bug fixes and quality of life improvements from the initial release last summer.

If you played the earlier build, you'll find this is an overhaul of the story. It starts at a different place a bit further along in the plot. This is largely a structural change. The scenes from the previous build are not gone forever. Instead, some of them will return as flashbacks deeper into the story.

If you come across any bugs or other issues while playing, please let us know by emailing support@mynagames.com, and we'll do our best to address your issue as soon as we can.

What's next?
These chapters are the first half of the first episode of the story. We're releasing those now with the intention of putting out the remaining three chapters in this episode early this year.

We'll update the store page as we get closer to that release.
